sloka: चन्द्रकेतोश्च मल्लस्य मल्लभूम्यां निवेशिता ।चन्द्रकान्तेति विख्याता दिव्या स्वर्गपुरी यथा ।। ७.१०२.९ ॥
transliteration: candraketośca mallasya mallabhūmyāṁ niveśitā ।candrakānteti vikhyātā divyā svargapurī yathā ।। 7.102.9 ॥

translations.english: And for Chandraketu, a city named Chandrakanta was established in the land of Malla, renowned as divine, just like a city of heaven.
